target_domain.equation: partial_t u + (u dot grad)u = -grad p + nu Delta u; div u=0
target_domain.solution_scope: unique smooth classical solution on its local existence interval from the frozen trigonometric datum

quantity.name: enstrophy
quantity.stretching_integral: P(v)=integral_T3 curl(v) dot ((curl(v) dot grad)v) dx

frozen_evaluator.method: exact symbolic differentiation, expansion, and trigonometric integration over [0,2pi]^3
required_checks: P(v) and D(v) are computed exactly
the enstrophy balance is independently recomputed from omega_t=nu Delta omega+(omega dot grad)u-(u dot grad)omega

preregistered_result_branches.authority: exact counterexample to the proposed transfer condition only

preregistered_result_branches.condition: exact derivation or identity check fails

falsifier_scope: A positive derivative disproves the universal claim that unweighted enstrophy is nonincreasing for every smooth 3D periodic Navier-Stokes solution.
non_guarantees: does not exclude a weighted, localized, scale-critical, or corrected Navier-Stokes monotone
does not construct a singular solution
does not establish or refute global regularity
does not transfer Ricci surgery, canonical neighborhoods, noncollapse, or finite extinction
